chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The siwak (brushing of teeth) removes the tear (from the eyes) and polishes the vision.

key_terms.السِّوَاكُ: Siwak (chew stick or toothbrush used for oral hygiene)

ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of using siwak according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this concise narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) underscores the siwak as a prophetic tradition (Sunnah) that bridges physical hygiene with spiritual purity. The mention of removing 'tears' and clarifying 'vision' reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that oral care not only prevents disease but also enhances one's presence of mind and spiritual clarity during worship.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Hammad Bin Isa, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The brushing of teeth removes the tears and polishes the vision’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from Hammad ibn ‘Isa who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Tooth brushing stops tears and sharpens eyesight.’”
